# Slack dump digest — 2026-08-02 resweep

Source: `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\reports\channel-dumps-2026-08-02-resweep\slack\`  
Dump stamp: ~`2026-08-02T18:55Z`. Many channels only carry the same Ava broadcasts; unique signal is concentrated in `#development-feed`, `#all-rootmc`, `#--general-chat--`, `#new-plugin-development-plans`, `#work-log`, `#server-reports`, `#decisions`.

---

## Status contradictions (resolve first)

| Claim | When / where | Conflict |
|---|---|---|
| 1.8.0 uploaded; **waiting Shockbyte restart both hosts** | Ava 01:40 `#development-feed` | Later RCON claim says live |
| Claims + Towny **UP**, suite **1.8.0**, `up-to-date=25`, TPS 20 | Alex/Ava voice 02:02 `#development-feed` | Latest brief still gates on restart |
| **Gate:** confirm Shockbyte restart / FileZilla; clear `waiting_restart` | Ava full-day brief **18:02** (most rooms) | Implies verification still open despite RCON |

**Net:** Treat 1.8.0 as *claimed live but not formally closed* until Alex confirms jars + clears `waiting_restart` / Skills MySQL pool / no zip END errors.

---

## Waiting on Alex (operator gates)

1. **`ava.rootmc.net` Cloudflare Tunnel + Access** → host `:8787` status UI (staff-only). Greenlight DNS/tunnel asked Aug 1; still open urgent in 18:02 brief.
2. **Confirm 1.8.0 live** — restart/FileZilla verification + clear `waiting_restart` jobs (brief still open even after RCON claim).
3. **Root-Ava-Core** — soft verbal OK in `#--general-chat--` (“That’s no problem”); formal rule: **governance PROP + docs; no live jar until Alex greenlights after PROP**.
4. **Legacy RootMC Official bot** — **do not kick** until Ava parity checklist is green (supersedes soft “retire the old bot” ask).
5. **OptiPlex → Ubuntu** — keep D→E Work Stations mirror updated; **full cutover parked**. Alex told Ava to *request* Linux-ops focus in `#development-feed` after current digs — **no formal Ava request post visible** in dumps.
6. **Worker deploy** for weekly-awards code fixes (bot exclusion + anti-triple-post). Code claimed done; **deploy not claimed**.
7. **Lodge figure-out DM** — still waiting on their reply (Ava dig update).
8. **Website PROP / ~$100 USD tools** — no spend until vote passes.
9. **Questions/decisions → Alex on Telegram** (EOD Telegram-only); Slack gets status flips.
10. **RootRecord shared Ava imaging/app + Kilauea/Google awareness** — Alex asked Ava; **no Ava answer in dump**.
11. **Melee: “getting rid of Towny once 26.3?”** — **unanswered**; brief says Towny through 26.3 stays on roadmap.

---
